text:
I went to this clinic today for a dental appointment. I was unimpressed from the moment I got the procedure done. The receptionist said to me, "Your teeth are so big!" This was inappropriate and unprofessional. We didn't know each other, and it was a personal matter and shouldn't be used as a joke.

When I asked about re-scheduling a dental filling appointment, I just started by saying, "Do you have any appointments available tomorrow?" Not knowing that dental appointments need to be spaced three to five days apart, the receptionist immediately interrupted me with a stern voice and a serious expression, "No, they need to be spaced three to five days apart." Before I could finish, she was unfriendly. I felt more like I was being scolded than treated.

Overall, I feel this clinic needs to improve its staff's #manners and attitudes. The receptionist's service directly affects the clinic's image. If this continues, no one will want to return.
